To resolve the **403 Forbidden** error on deployment, I have updated `index.tsx` to include an **API Key Management System**.

**The Issue:**
The 403 error occurs because the hardcoded API key likely has referrer restrictions (e.g., restricted to `localhost` or specific domains) or the Project quota/billing does not allow access to the `gemini-3-pro-preview` model from your deployed URL.

**The Fix:**
I have added a "Settings" feature that allows you to input your own API Key directly in the app. This key is saved locally in your browser so you don't need to re-enter it. I also added a toggle for "Google Search Grounding" because restricted keys often fail when search tools are enabled without proper billing.

**Changes made:**
1.  **Added Settings Modal:** Click the "Gear" icon in the header to open the configuration panel.
2.  **Custom Key Logic:** The app now prioritizes your custom key over the default one.
3.  **Error Handling:** If a 403 error is detected, the app explicitly guides you to the Settings panel to fix it.
4.  **Google Search Toggle:** Added a switch to disable `googleSearch` tool, which is a common cause of 403 errors on non-billed projects.

**What you need to do:**
1.  Deploy the updated code.
2.  Click the **Gear Icon** (top right).
3.  Enter a valid **Gemini API Key** (get one from [aistudio.google.com](https://aistudio.google.com/)).
4.  If it still fails, try **disabling "Google Search Grounding"** in the settings.
